reading.title: The Parts of a Story
reading.purpose: Learn the parts that make up a story.
paras: Every story has parts. The setting tells where and when it happens. An event is a thing that happens. Some stories are an adventure.
A story may have a problem and a solution. The solution fixes the problem. A story may teach a lesson. Now imagine your own story!
